summary: v8.1.3 full-universe search backend: 33/33 pytest passed in 29s (test_iter19_v813_search.py). All review-request search cases confirmed via public URL: crypto cascade (BTC/MOODENG/MEW/BRETT/AAVE all return crypto hits with non-empty sparklines; CAT returns Caterpillar stock_us; POPCAT returns 200 with graceful empty result — no 5xx as spec allows); IDX low-cap (AADI/DSSA/WBSA/DOOH/ERAA/MSIN/VKTR all present in stock_id map); COCO returns both stock_id COCO AND commodity COCOA (contains-match); world stocks all resolve — TOYOTA→7203.T, TSMC_TW→2330.TW, TENCENT→0700.HK, DBS→D05.SI, MOUTAI→600519.SS, HSBC→0005.HK, SAMSUNG→005930.KS, MAYBANK→1155.KL; SBER returns 200 gracefully (Russia — no 5xx as spec allows). Startup resilience verified: backend serves /api/search?q=BTC despite api.binance.com 451 geo-block (data-api.binance.vision + Bitget cascade path working). Response shape contract confirmed: {hits[], query, disambiguation[]}. Regression clean: /api/dashboard?market=crypto|stock_us returns 50+ assets under `assets` key; /api/dashboard/batch returns all 7 markets under `markets` dict with server_time+timeframe; /api/asset/crypto/BTC/chart returns candles; POST /api/asset/crypto/BTC/analyze returns AI content; /api/chat/messages 200. Minor contract drift: /api/subscription/health now returns 5 keys including a string `package_name` (previously boolean-only per iter18 note) — no secret/PII leaked (verified no private_key/client_email/service_account.json/PEM markers). No expo/react-native deprecated packages touched in this iteration.

minor.issue: Contract drift vs iter18 note: response is no longer boolean-only. Now returns {service_account_env_set: bool, service_account_path_exists: bool, service_account_inline_json: bool, publisher_client_initialised: bool, package_name: 'com.cryptostockapps.aicryptostockpro'}. `package_name` is a public app bundle id (not a secret) and no PII/keys are leaked, but the review-request contract explicitly asked for boolean-only. Non-blocking — main agent to decide whether to drop `package_name` from the shape or accept the drift and update the contract.

critical_code_review_comments: Search endpoint response shape is stable across all 24 tested queries — always returns {hits, query, disambiguation} with correct types. No 5xx observed even for edge cases (POPCAT with CoinGecko rate-limit, SBER with Russia data unavailable).

Binance geo-block resilience is real: /api/search?q=BTC returned a full BTC crypto hit with 30-point sparkline despite api.binance.com being 451 in this container — data-api.binance.vision mirror path and Bitget cascade are correctly wired.
COCO cross-market disambiguation working: single query returns COCO (stock_id) in hits AND COCOA (commodity) — confirms the contains-match logic across the multi-market universe.
World-stock alias map is comprehensive: 8/8 tested aliases (TOYOTA/TSMC_TW/TENCENT/DBS/MOUTAI/HSBC/SAMSUNG/MAYBANK) resolve to their Yahoo suffix tickers.

Dashboard/batch endpoint shape is {markets: {crypto:{assets:[...]}, ...}, timeframe, server_time} — nested, not flat. Any downstream client must dereference `.markets.<market>.assets`. Confirm frontend does this correctly (mentioned as tested manually by main agent).
